use_case: Use the checklist during scope-change pricing and authorization when the construction change order record must identify contract scope, affected drawing references, schedule milestones, and cost codes. Complete the applicable handoff for signed disposition, revised contract value, schedule update, distribution record, and cost-code handoff.
